query:
SELECT EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM chats c
               WHERE c.id = ?2
                 AND (c.dm_user_id = ?1
                      OR (c.kind = 'group' AND EXISTS(
                          SELECT 1 FROM chat_members m
                          WHERE m.chat_id = c.id AND m.user_id = ?1)))
           ) AS "in_chat!: bool"
